newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Aluminium Bahrain expansion comes on stream.
newsitem.headline: Aluminium Bahrain expansion comes on stream.

text.p: A $130 million expansion project at Aluminium Bahrain BSC (Alba) came on stream on January 1 and would increase the smelter's production by 36,500 tonnes a year to around half a million tonnes by mid-1997.
"Seventy-six new cells started production in the new year at a capacity of 25,000 tonnes a year," a company official told Reuters on Sunday.
He said the new cells would produce at their full capacity of 36,500 tonnes a year when part of the overall expansion -- a $58.5 million upgrade of Alba's power plant -- is completed in May 1997.
Alba awarded ABB Kraftwerke, part of Asea Brown Boveri AG the $58.5 million contract in 1995 to install a 146-megawatt gas turbine and associated equipment as part of the smelter's expansion.
"Alba's production will increase to around half a million tonnes of aluminium by the middle of this year," the official said.
He said Alba, the biggest aluminium producer in the Middle East, produced over 460,000 tonnes in 1996.
Alba is 77 percent owned by the Bahraini government and 20 percent held by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund. German group Breton Investments holds the rest.
